The scale should be small (e.g., 5-10) to bridge the gap between near-success and true success without causing the out_of_bounds behavior seen in iter_002. The crash_penalty must remain at -50. The fuel_penalty must remain at -0.05 (unconditional). The success_bonus conditions must remain unchanged (|angle|<0.1, |x|<0.1, y<0.2, |vx|<0.1, |vy|<0.1).
